mapper.insert: insert into cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_outbox_event (id, message_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, message_type, event_name, schema_version, routing_key, payload, headers, status, attempt_count, available_at) values (#{id}, #{messageId}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{messageType}, #{eventName}, #{schemaVersion}, #{routingKey}, cast(#{payload} as jsonb), cast(#{headers} as jsonb), #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{availableAt})
mapper.select: with candidates as ( select id from cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_outbox_event where (status = 'PENDING' and available_at <= #{now}) or (status = 'PUBLISHING' and claimed_at <= #{now}) order by id for update skip locked limit #{limit} ) update cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_outbox_event event set status = 'PUBLISHING', claimed_at = #{leaseUntil}, claimed_by = #{leaseOwner}, updated_at = now() from candidates where event.id = candidates.id returning event.id, event.message_id, event.aggregate_type, event.aggregate_id, event.message_type, event.event_name, event.schema_version, event.routing_key, event.payload::text as payload, event.headers::text as headers, event.status, event.attempt_count, event.available_at;
mapper.update: update cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_outbox_event set status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt}, claimed_at = null, claimed_by = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PUBLISHING' and claimed_by = #{leaseOwner}

update cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_outbox_event set status = 'PENDING', available_at = #{availableAt}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, claimed_at = null, claimed_by = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PUBLISHING' and claimed_by = #{leaseOwner}

update cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_outbox_event set status = 'FAILED', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, claimed_at = null, claimed_by = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PUBLISHING' and claimed_by = #{leaseOwner}
